scope: PeerOde::solve: explicit (never default-routed) end-to-end PPSW1-6b solve from the facade Problem
admission through MethodRegistry (U06) before any callback: mass, events, unqualified, per-step/startup permission refusals are typed

minimal lowering of the facade Problem for the Peer subset only (Jacobian::Dense or Jacobian::Jvp, identity mass, no events); solve.rs::build is private and outside the allowlist, so finite-difference and banded problems are refused, not lowered
endpoint consistency: h0 = min(rule/user h0, (t_end - t0)/2) so the starter never passes t_end; final step clipped to t_end exactly
transactional loop over ppsw1::Session::try_step; accepted prefix (t, y) retained on typed failure; startup and step work buckets separate; rejected work stays charged
method-owned state: the Peer six-stage history lives only inside PeerOde; no switching API (typed MethodSwitchUnsupported) because no history transfer certificate exists
not_in_scope: BDF/Radau facade adapters (existing observed drivers stay on their exports)
independent_review: required by the contract; not performed by the implementing agent (NOT_RUN)
